title: Removing the lead asks to clear shifts, the same as changing it
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Work Orders page on the build under test, signed in with permission to reassign work orders.
  2. A work order (for example S2-17578) has a current lead technician who has scheduled shifts on the Schedule.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reassign lead technician dialog (or the work order's detail page) and remove the lead technician, moving the work order to Unassigned.
  2. Read the prompt that appears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Removing the lead technician (moving the work order to Unassigned) shows the same shift-clearing prompt as changing it (S4-R11).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician.
